# UXellent

UXellent is an AI website builder for businesses and professionals. The AI builds a complete site for the business, with its own content and design, and the owner makes changes in a chat or by clicking on the page.

Main website (Hebrew): https://uxellent.com
English: https://uxellent.com/en

## What every site includes

- Every page is built with SEO and structured business data, and is ready for AI search
- Fast on every device; hosting and SSL included
- A contact form and a WhatsApp button; every enquiry is saved in the system and emailed to the owner, and it is saved even if the email fails
- The enquiries address is verified by email
- Automatic nightly backup, 30 nights back
- Changes in the chat or click-to-edit; import from an existing site
- Own domain on the Business and Pro plans
- Built with accessibility in mind
